# Native context-menu fixture, not product compatibility

Unpublished warm-worker/top-level/observer-present feasibility fixture. The genuine worker registers
one editable-context item through contextMenus.create and records its actual callback/lastError.
Only native contextMenus.onClicked performs primary injection using the event-provided tab ID.
There is no website bridge, host permission, tabs permission, content script, fake event or host-created
substitute item. Preflight and retained-event-ID retry remain separate negative injection attempts.

The pending native observation gate performs a confined real right-click, records the exact native
receiving view/editable/menu-item tree, and permits only a verified owned-menu Escape cancellation.
It requires no onClicked event, unchanged documents and fresh permission denial. Ambiguous topology
gets no global Escape/EndMenu. Failure cleanup uses a retained handle to this exact isolated test
process and is itself a failing outcome, not acceptance. Actual item selection and full duplicate-view/
no-activeTab/cross-origin controls remain unimplemented. No Windows execution is claimed. No Bitwarden autofill, iframe, cold-worker, menu availability or grant claim follows
from this source. Packages and fixture keys are public development material, not signed-store provenance.
